central_question: What will the LBMA/COMEX spot price of gold in US dollars per troy ounce be at the end of 31 December 2027, given the late-October 2026 baseline of roughly $4,099/oz and the balance of central bank buying, Fed policy and real yields, the dollar, inflation and geopolitical risk?

situation_brief.current_situation: Gold traded at $4,099.20/oz on 21 October 2026 (WGC spot; Macrotrends composite $4,132), down 4.4% YTD and 23.2% below the 29 January 2026 all-time high of $5,501.70 (LBMA a.m.). COMEX Dec 2026 settled $4,092.50 and Dec 2027 at $4,363.70. The Fed is on a hawkish pivot: policy rate 3.875%, September 2026 hike, 10-year TIPS at 2.638% (top of five-year range), CPI 3.717% y/y.
situation_brief.context: After +25% in 2024 (close $2,610.85) and roughly +65% in 2025 with the January 2026 record, gold corrected nearly 27% to a June 2026 close of $4,026.05, touching $3,994.50 on 25 June. ETF holdings hit a record 4,256t in September 2026 (+67t, contrarian inflows); central banks bought a Q2-record 289t but H1 of 345t was the weakest since 2022. Mine output hit a record H1 of 1,867t; total supply flat y/y.
situation_brief.dynamics: A real-yield shock is contesting a firm demand floor. Markets price ~77bp of cumulative Fed tightening through October 2027 against an SEP median holding 4.25% through 2028; a December 2026 hike is priced at 73.3%. Bank 2027 targets cluster at $5,000-5,600, well above the futures-implied centre of ~$4,360. Turkey (-82t YTD) and Russia (-56t YTD) are official sellers; Poland nears its 700t target.
fault_lines: Hawkish Fed path and record-high real yields versus record ETF holdings and continued central bank buying
Realised CPI at 3.717% versus anchored 10-year breakevens at 2.351% and SEP PCE falling to 2.4% in 2027
Market pricing of hikes versus SEP median and the Base scenario's assumed gradual cuts
Turkey and Russia liquidating official gold against Poland, China, Uzbekistan and Czech buying
Futures-implied centre (~$4,360) far below bank consensus (~$5,400)
Thin far-dated COMEX liquidity (1,166 Dec 2027 contracts vs 315,599 Dec 2026)
catalysts: US midterms 3 November 2026 and Spain snap election 29 November 2026
9 December 2026 FOMC + SEP (73.3% one cumulative hike)
2027 FOMC meetings (27 Jan through 27 Oct 2027); ~77bp tightening priced
France presidential rounds 18 April and 2 May 2027; Poland and Italy elections late 2027
NBP reaching its 700t target; PBoC monthly reserve updates; monthly WGC ETF flows
